Kekaflow chat assistant

A chat page inside Grafana. Ask in plain language about any metric, logs, alerts, or unusual behavior, and a Claude model answers from live data. It is built with Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) and uses mcp-grafana for Grafana's own tools.

Features Quick start Ask a question Anomaly detection API Targets Choose the model Settings Security Troubleshooting Changelog

Related guides: GPU observability stack, Build and deploy Grafana with Docker Compose. Full reference: chat-assistant.md.

Features

  • Answers questions about metrics, logs, alerts, and dashboards, using live data.
  • Finds anomalies: spikes, dips, level shifts, flatlines, and gaps, with the time they started and the labels the affected series share.
  • Streams the answer as it is written, and shows every tool call so you can see the query that ran.
  • Read-only by default: tools that change Grafana are blocked.
  • Runs as a Grafana app plugin. Grafana checks the login and keeps the agent's token secret.
  • Keeps a separate conversation for each user.
  • Lets an organization admin choose the model on a Settings page: Anthropic directly, or any model behind a LiteLLM proxy. Save and test confirms that it answers.

Quick start

The assistant is part of the full stack. Start it with the observability services, Keycloak, Grafana, and mcp-grafana. This reuses the Grafana image. Run make stack-deploy instead to build it first.

make stack-up

The command creates CHAT_AGENT_TOKEN in .env. Add your Claude API key there, then recreate the agent:

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=<YOUR_API_KEY>     # in .env

make chat-restart

Open http://localhost:3000/a/kekaflow-chat-app, or choose More apps, then Kekaflow Assistant, in the Grafana menu. The header shows the model, the number of Grafana tools, and Read-only. Without a model, every question answers with "No API key is configured". Either set the key as above, or choose the model on the Settings page (see Choose the model).

Ask a question

Pick a suggestion or type your own. Press Enter to send and Shift+Enter for a new line. Choose Stop to cancel an answer, and New chat to start over. Open a tool call to see its query and result.

TopicExample
MetricsWhich GPUs are running hottest right now? Group them by region.
LogsDid the number of error logs change in the last hour? Which nodes log the most errors?
AlertsWhich alert rules are firing or pending right now?
DashboardsSummarize the GPU fleet overview dashboard and what each panel shows.
AnomaliesIs there anything unusual in GPU temperature over the last 3 hours? Tell me when it started and where.

Name a time range when it matters. The assistant knows the current time. The conversation is kept in the browser tab until you close it.

Anomaly detection

The built-in tools detect_metric_anomalies and detect_log_anomalies analyze every series a query returns and rank them. They use the median and the median absolute deviation, so a few extreme points don't distort the baseline.

FindingMeaning
spike / dipA short run of points far above or below the baseline.
level_shiftThe series moved to a new level and stayed. The timestamp is the best-fit step.
flatlineA series that normally varies became constant.
gapSamples are missing for four steps or more.
  • Cycles: repeating workloads are detected and compared with the same phase of the cycle, so normal cycling isn't reported.
  • Shared labels: it reports the label values the anomalous series share, for example datacenter=dub1, with their coverage and lift.
  • Simultaneous changes: it reports when many series changed at once.

Limits: use a window that includes normal behavior, at least a few times longer than the anomaly. A series needs 12 points. Up to 300 series are analyzed per query. The default sensitivity is 4.5 robust standard deviations. Ask for 3 to see more, or 7 to see only clear ones. The anomaly tools read VictoriaMetrics and VictoriaLogs only.

Agent API

Grafana exposes the agent at /api/plugin-proxy/kekaflow-chat-app/agent/ and adds the token. Calling the agent directly needs Authorization: Bearer <CHAT_AGENT_TOKEN>, except for /healthz.

MethodPathDescription
GET/healthzHealth. No token.
GET/configModel, MCP state and tool names, built-in tools, limits.
POST/chatAsk a question, streamed as server-sent events.
POST/llm/testOne small request with the model in the X-LLM-* headers. Returns {"ok": true} or {"ok": false, "error"}.
GET/llm/modelsModels the provider offers for the X-LLM-* headers.
DELETE/sessions/{sessionId}Forget a conversation.
 
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $CHAT_AGENT_TOKEN" -H "X-Grafana-User: me" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"message": "How many GPUs are reporting?", "session_id": "demo-session-1"}' \
  http://localhost:8081/chat
EventData
session{"session_id"}. Always first.
tool_call{"id", "name", "args"}
tool_result{"id", "name", "ok", "preview"}
text{"delta"}, a piece of the answer.
error{"message"}, safe to show users.
done{"input_tokens", "output_tokens"}. Always last.

Errors before the stream starts return {"error": "..."} with status 400, 401, 409, or 413.

Choose the model

By default the agent uses CHAT_AGENT_MODEL and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from .env. An organization admin can pick another model without a restart:

  1. In Grafana, open Administration, Plugins and data, Plugins, then Kekaflow Assistant.
  2. Select the Settings tab and choose a provider under Language model.
  3. Select Save and test. The page shows whether the model answered, how long it took, and why it failed if it didn't.
ProviderFields
Agent defaultNone. Uses the agent's own model and key.
AnthropicModel, for example claude-sonnet-5-5. API key; leave it empty to use ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
LiteLLM proxyProxy address, for example http://litellm:4000. Model, the name your proxy exposes. API key, if the proxy needs one.

The choice applies to the whole organization, and only admins can change it. Grafana stores the key encrypted and never returns it to the browser. The agent doesn't store it.

The agent only calls hosts listed in CHAT_AGENT_ALLOWED_LLM_HOSTS (default api.anthropic.com,litellm,fake-llm; remove fake-llm, the test stand-in, for shared deployments). A host name matches any port, and host:port matches one port. Run make chat-restart after you change it.

CHAT_AGENT_ALLOWED_LLM_HOSTS=api.anthropic.com,litellm,litellm.internal:4000

Grafana replaces the plugin settings with its provisioning file on every start, so a model chosen on the Settings page resets on restart unless you also set it in .env, then run make stack-up:

CHAT_LLM_PROVIDER=litellm     # empty, anthropic, or litellm
CHAT_LLM_BASE_URL=http://litellm:4000
CHAT_LLM_MODEL=claude-sonnet
CHAT_LLM_API_KEY=<YOUR_PROXY_KEY>

Settings

Set these in .env. make chat-env appends them.

VariableDefaultDescription
CHAT_AGENT_TOKENgeneratedShared secret between Grafana and the agent. Required.
ANTHROPIC_API_KEYemptyClaude API key.
CHAT_AGENT_MODELanthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5Any model LiteLLM can reach with the key.
CHAT_AGENT_ALLOWED_LLM_HOSTSapi.anthropic.com,litellm,fake-llmHosts the Settings page may point the agent at.
CHAT_LLM_PROVIDER, CHAT_LLM_BASE_URL, CHAT_LLM_MODEL, CHAT_LLM_API_KEYemptyProvision the model on Grafana's side so it survives a restart.
CHAT_AGENT_PORT8081Host port for debugging, bound to 127.0.0.1.
CHAT_AGENT_ALLOW_WRITESfalseAllow tools that change Grafana.
CHAT_AGENT_EXTRA_INSTRUCTIONemptyText appended to the system prompt.
CHAT_AGENT_LOG_LEVELINFOLog level.

Advanced settings of the agent service, such as MCP_GRAFANA_URL, CHAT_AGENT_METRICS_URL, CHAT_AGENT_LOGS_URL, CHAT_AGENT_MAX_LLM_CALLS, and the session limits, are in the reference.

Security

  • Grafana stores the token encrypted and never sends it to the browser. Any signed-in user with the Viewer role can open the page.
  • The agent reads with the permissions of mcp-grafana, not with those of the person asking. By default mcp-grafana signs in as the Grafana admin, and the anomaly tools read the Victoria data without per-tenant filtering. In the two-tenant Keycloak demo, every user who can open the page can ask about every tenant's data. Set MCP_GRAFANA_TOKEN to a scoped service account before you share the page with tenants who must stay apart.
  • Questions and the data that tools return are sent to the provider you chose: Anthropic, or your LiteLLM proxy and the models behind it.
  • Only admins can change the model. The plugin proxy replaces any X-LLM-* headers a browser sends, and the agent only calls allowed hosts. The key travels from Grafana to the agent on every request, so use TLS between separate hosts.
  • Provider errors are logged and replaced with a fixed message in the browser.

Troubleshooting

  • The assistant service is not reachable: run docker compose ps chat-agent and make chat-logs, and check that the plugin is enabled under Administration, Plugins and data.
  • Grafana could not authenticate to the assistant service: the token differs. Both read CHAT_AGENT_TOKEN from .env. Run make stack-up after you change it.
  • No API key is configured, or the key was rejected: set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in .env and run make chat-restart, or enter a key on the Settings page and select Save and test.
  • The proxy host isn't allowed: add the host to CHAT_AGENT_ALLOWED_LLM_HOSTS and run make chat-restart.
  • The header shows "Model settings invalid": the saved settings are incomplete. Fix the field the message names on the Settings page and select Save and test.
  • The model resets after Grafana restarts: set the CHAT_LLM_* variables in .env and run make stack-up.
  • Cannot reach the model provider: the address must resolve from the agent's network. Use the service name, not localhost, and check make chat-logs.
  • The key field says "configured" and you want none: select Reset next to the key, then Save and test.
  • Grafana tools offline: the agent can't reach mcp-grafana. Hover over the badge for the reason, and check MCP_GRAFANA_URL.
  • The plugin is missing: Grafana needs GF_PLUGINS_ALLOW_LOADING_UNSIGNED_PLUGINS=kekaflow-chat-app, which the compose file sets. Check the Grafana log for kekaflow-chat-app.
  • The anomaly tools fail: check CHAT_AGENT_METRICS_URL and CHAT_AGENT_LOGS_URL, and that the query returns data in Grafana.
  • Other organizations don't have the page: provisioning enables it for the main organization. Enable the plugin in the other organization and set agentUrl and agentToken.

Changelog

  • Added the kekaflow-chat-app Grafana app plugin: a streaming chat page with tool-call details and suggested questions.
  • Added the grafana-chat-agent service (backend/services/grafana-chat-agent), built with Google ADK and Claude, connected to mcp-grafana.
  • Added the anomaly toolkit: spikes, dips, level shifts, flatlines, gaps, cycles, shared labels, and simultaneous changes.
  • Added docker-compose.chat.yml, make chat-* targets, unit and end-to-end tests, and CI jobs that run them.
  • Added the helm/grafana-chat-agent chart.
  • Added a Settings page to the plugin to choose Anthropic or a LiteLLM proxy, with Save and test and a model list. Added /llm/test and /llm/models, the CHAT_AGENT_ALLOWED_LLM_HOSTS allowlist, the CHAT_LLM_* provisioning variables, and the chart value agent.allowedLlmHosts.
